review:
Das xBoot is the original 6x4 submarine slot that introduced xBomb. Four-row xNudge Wilds gain +1 to their multiplier with every nudge, xWays symbols reveal two or three of the same symbol to add ways, and xBomb Wilds blow away non-winning symbols on their reel while raising the multiplier.

Three bonus symbols award eight Silent Hunter Spins, where all three mechanics can combine. Nolimit rates it Extreme volatility, with a 55,200x cap. It set the template for the sequel, Das xBoot 2wei!
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
